claims: PlayStation Plus is adding Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, Persona 5 Royal, and Blasphemous 2 to the Extra and Premium Game Catalog on March 17, 2026.
The March 2026 monthly games for all tiers include Slime Rancher 2, Monster Hunter Rise, PGA Tour 2K25, and The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road Collection.
March 2026 monthly games for all tiers are available until April 6, 2026.
PlayStation Plus Essential tier includes monthly games and online multiplayer.
PlayStation Plus Extra tier includes Essential plus Game Catalog with hundreds of PS4/PS5 games.
PlayStation Plus Premium/Deluxe tier includes Extra plus Classics Catalog plus Game Trials.
